title: Ascensia and Sava Partner for Next-Gen Diabetes Microsensors
summary: Ascensia partners with Sava Technologies to commercialize minimally invasive glucose monitoring microsensors targeting CE approval within 18 to 24 months.

title: Black Hills to Build Gas Generation and Microgrid for Google
summary: Black Hills Corp. plans $1.8 billion in natural gas generation and will manage a 2.1-GW microgrid for Google's Wyoming data center.

title: Starship Ship 42 Undergoes Cryo Proof Testing
summary: Ship 42 for Flight 15 has headed back out to Massey’s for additional cryo-proof testing.

title: Defence Satcom Revenues Projected to Surpass $23bn by 2035
summary: Novaspace released its Satellite Communications for Defense and Security report projecting global military satcom revenues to exceed $23 billion by 2035.

title: Axiom Space Highlights Orbital Computing Progress
summary: Axiom Space announced progress on its orbital compute strategy, specifically regarding the Axiom Resilient Compute platform.

title: UK and Germany Partner on Critical Infrastructure
summary: The UK and Germany agreed to cooperate to address threats to their critical national infrastructure.

title: Hidden Materials Discovered for Batteries and Solar Fuels
summary: Scientists discovered new intermediate materials and a distinct form of bismuth vanadate that could enhance solar fuels and electronics.

title: Delivery Drone Air Traffic Controllers Emerge
summary: Remote pilots in command are managing neighborhood drone delivery services as commercial autonomous flights expand.

title: Physical AI Requires Neuromorphic Architecture
summary: Physical AI applications face real-world limitations unless neuromorphic paths connect sensors directly to silicon.

title: Quantum Bethe Strings Observed in Ultracold Gas
summary: Researchers have created and observed unusual quantum states known as Bethe strings using ultracold cesium atoms.

title: Siemens Streamlines Scaling 3D IC Design
summary: Siemens Innovator3D IC aims to streamline 3D integrated circuit design from initial planning to final implementation.

title: Chip Industry Highlights: Foundry Pacts and Hyper-NA
summary: Recent semiconductor industry developments include a $2 billion foundry pact, hyper-NA EUV updates, and financial reports.

title: Rockwell Joins Pharmaceutical Digitization Consortium
summary: Rockwell joined an initiative to develop digital standards and AI-enabled tools across the drug development lifecycle.

title: Seeq and Cognizant Partner for Pharma Industrial AI
summary: Seeq and Cognizant are collaborating to bring scalable OEE monitoring and industrial AI to regulated manufacturing sites.

title: Arm Versus Qualcomm Legal Case Concludes
summary: The legal battle between Arm and Qualcomm in Delaware has concluded, awaiting final rulings from the judge and jury.

title: ASML Launches Hyper-NA EUV Development
summary: ASML started a ten-year program to develop a Hyper-NA EUV lithography tool aimed at achieving 5nm feature sizes.

title: TSMC September Revenue Climbs 54% Year-Over-Year
summary: TSMC reported a September revenue of $16.1 billion, representing a 54.6% increase compared to September 2025.

title: Self-Buoyant Spheroid Culture Enables Programmable Multi-Spheroid Assembly
summary: Researchers demonstrated a self-buoyant cell culture method using microbubbles for high-throughput, field-free multi-spheroid assembly and rapid fluid transfer.

title: Correlated Electron Conduction Found in WO3 Ferroelastic Walls
summary: Surface-exposed ferroelastic twin walls in epitaxial WO3 films act as intrinsic one-dimensional channels with significantly enhanced conductance.

title: DNA Nanodevice-Engineered Macrophages Act as Living Sensors
summary: Engineered macrophages utilizing DNA origami nanodevices convert endogenous microenvironmental signals into state-specific reporter outputs for tumor monitoring.

title: Cement-Based Supercapacitors Enable Buildings to Store Energy
summary: Scientists have developed an experimental cement-based supercapacitor that could allow building materials to store power.

title: Dex-One2Many Learns Dexterous Manipulation from Video
summary: A new framework enables robotic hands to learn generalizable dexterous manipulation from a single human video.

title: VersaCamVLA Introduces Camera-Configurable Robot Manipulation
summary: VersaCamVLA is a new framework that allows Vision-Language-Action policies to adapt to variable camera configurations and poses.

title: RoboRSI: Robot Self-Evolution via Top-Down Skill Refinement
summary: Researchers introduced RoboRSI, a robot self-improvement system that decomposes tasks into scoped skills, attributes execution outcomes, and accumulates reusable compound behaviors.

title: LeWAM: JEPA World Action Model with Diffusion-Steering MPC
summary: LeWAM is a decoder-free JEPA latent model designed for forward, backward, inverse dynamics and policy prediction, enhancing robot state reading and planning.

title: PI-UDF: Physics-Informed Collision Learning for Collaborative Robots
summary: PI-UDF combines analytical kinematics and learnable embeddings to predict differentiable body-to-body collision distances for real-time multi-arm motion optimization.

title: Interference-Aware Downlink Power Control for HAPS Networks
summary: A new analytical and optimization framework for downlink power allocation in high-altitude platform stations achieves up to a 6 dB reduction in required transmit power.

title: Embodied Turing Machines: Code-Only-as-Policy for Robots
summary: Code-Only-as-Policy measures and tracks robot and task state entirely in code without a VLM or VLA in the control loop, achieving high success rates on bimanual tasks.

title: LiteNWM: Efficient Latent World Models for Visual Navigation
summary: LiteNWM shares visual encoding across candidates to predict future representations, improving navigation success rates and drastically reducing trajectory error and inference speedup.

title: Convex Safety Filtering via Spectral Selection for Nonconvex Safe Sets
summary: Selecting eigenvectors of a matrix function yields a convex input constraint that guarantees a geometric lower bound on eigenvalues for safe sets defined by matrix concave functions.
